scope.officialPoolSampling: Four graph questions from each of the five 2014/2015 suites, with vector construction, individual graph choices, matching, function/integral graphs, boxplots and distributions. Selected from current exact aufgabenpool references.

methodology: Rendered every referenced source task PDF using full MediaBox and corresponding solution PDF whenever a solution/rubric figure was present. Displayed every actual PNG separately beside source pages, in69 boards; reviewed all114 assets rather than sampling assets.

Compared current JSON figure paths/pointers and sibling text for given-vs-option-vs-solution placement, original item order, full labels/edges and readability. Original given shading was distinguished from solution overlays.

For20 stratified pool samples visually compared the source question and current official pool first page, including printed Aufgabenummer, numerical/graph structure, individual candidates where present, and original examination footer. Verified current JSON URL against cached-download URL and PDF SHA.
One confirmed crop-edge defect was recropped from exactly the same originalPDF with unchanged interior; manually displayed final crop and compared pixels as supplemental evidence.
Review is a content/asset inspection, not a claim that all official references outside the20 selected questions were independently re-checked in this audit.69question JSON records were not edited.
